notes: The strip of steps across the top of the middle column is gone – move between the job, the quote, the confirmation and the rest by clicking them in the list under the job on the left. Going back to The job used to leave whichever email you had open sitting in the preview; it now shows the booking confirmation, so the preview always matches the step you are on. An uploaded logo keeps its own proportions instead of being squashed into the shape of the one the app ships with. And the panel that read replies out of Mail has been removed.
